audit_metadata.scope: genomics, onboarding, integration — remaining gaps after prior audits

gaps.title: No codon optimization for target organism expression
gaps.description: CRISPR design and protein analysis do not include codon optimization. For agricultural biotechnology, genes must be codon-optimized for the target crop species (e.g., rice, wheat, maize) to ensure high expression. No codon usage table integration exists.
gaps.current_state: CRISPRDesigner.design_guide() returns guide RNA sequences without considering codon usage bias for the target organism. ProteinAnalyzer does not back-translate protein sequences to optimized DNA.
gaps.expected: CodonOptimizer class with species-specific codon usage tables (from Codon Usage Database). Integrate into CRISPR design pipeline: after guide selection, optimize the donor DNA template codon usage. Provide back-translation for protein sequences.

gaps.title: No variant effect prediction (SIFT/PolyPhen-style)
gaps.description: No ability to predict whether a genetic variant is deleterious. Critical for assessing CRISPR off-target effects and for breeding program decisions. Cannot distinguish between synonymous, missense, and nonsense mutations.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented. No variant annotation or effect prediction.
gaps.expected: VariantEffectPredictor that classifies variants as synonymous/missense/nonsense/frameshift. Integration with protein analysis to predict impact on protein structure and function. SIFT-style conservation scoring or PolyPhen-style structural impact prediction.

gaps.title: No allergenicity or toxicity prediction for GMO safety
gaps.description: Agricultural biotechnology products require allergenicity and toxicity assessment before regulatory approval. No tools exist to screen novel proteins against known allergen databases or to predict toxicity.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented. ProteinAnalyzer provides basic properties but no safety assessment.
gaps.expected: AllergenicityPredictor using FAO/WHO decision tree approach (sequence similarity to known allergens, 8-mer exact match screening). ToxicityPredictor for hemolytic or cytotoxic peptide prediction. Integration with regulatory report generation.

gaps.title: No protein solubility prediction
gaps.description: Protein solubility is critical for agricultural biotechnology applications (e.g., engineering soluble enzymes for crop improvement). No prediction of whether a protein will be soluble when expressed in a heterologous system.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented. ProteinAnalyzer provides hydrophobicity but not solubility prediction.
gaps.expected: SolubilityPredictor using sequence features (charge, hydrophobicity, aromaticity). Integration with ProteinResult to flag insoluble proteins early in the design pipeline.

gaps.title: No protein subcellular localization prediction
gaps.description: For agricultural protein engineering, targeting proteins to specific organelles (chloroplast, mitochondria, nucleus) is essential. No prediction of where a protein will localize within a plant cell.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: SubcellularLocalizationPredictor using signal peptide detection, transit peptide recognition, and NLS/NES motif scanning. Predict localization to chloroplast, mitochondria, nucleus, ER, or secretion pathway.

gaps.title: No restriction site analysis for cloning
gaps.description: CRISPR construct design requires restriction enzyme analysis for cloning guide RNA expression cassettes. No ability to identify restriction sites in sequences or to design silent mutations to remove/add sites.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: RestrictionSiteAnalyzer with common enzyme database (EcoRI, BamHI, HindIII, etc.). Identify sites in guide sequences and donor templates. Suggest silent mutations to remove unwanted sites for Golden Gate or traditional cloning.

gaps.title: No primer design for PCR validation
gaps.description: After CRISPR guide design, PCR primers are needed for genotyping and validation. No automated primer design for amplifying target regions or for T7E1/Surveyor assays.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: PrimerDesigner that designs primers flanking the cut site for genotyping. Include melting temperature calculation, GC clamp checking, and dimer detection. Support for T7E1 assay primers and Sanger sequencing primers.

gaps.title: No protein post-translational modification prediction
gaps.description: Post-translational modifications (PTMs) like phosphorylation, glycosylation, and ubiquitination affect protein function in crops. No PTM site prediction exists.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: PTMPredictor for common modifications: N-linked glycosylation (N-X-S/T motif), phosphorylation (kinase-specific motifs), ubiquitination (degron motifs). Flag PTM sites in ProteinResult.

gaps.title: No GFF/GTF genome annotation format support
gaps.description: Cannot read or write GFF3/GTF files for genome annotations. Cannot integrate with standard genome annotation pipelines or export CRISPR targets with genomic coordinates.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented. No GFF/GTF parsing or serialization.
gaps.expected: GFF3 parser for reading gene, CDS, exon, and regulatory feature annotations. GTF parser for transcript-level annotations. Export CRISPR guide designs with genomic coordinates in GFF3 format.

gaps.title: No BED format support for genomic intervals
gaps.description: Cannot read or write BED files for genomic intervals. Cannot represent CRISPR target regions, off-target sites, or coverage tracks in standard BED format.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: BED parser and writer for genomic intervals. Support for BED3-BED12 formats. Export off-target sites and guide target regions as BED tracks for genome browser visualization.

gaps.title: No SBOL (Synthetic Biology Open Language) support
gaps.description: Cannot read or write SBOL files for synthetic biology designs. Cannot export CRISPR constructs or genetic circuits in standard synthetic biology format.
gaps.current_state: Not implemented.
gaps.expected: SBOL parser and writer for genetic design exchange. Export CRISPR guide RNA cassettes, donor templates, and regulatory elements as SBOL components.

gaps.title: Event bus has no persistence — events lost on restart
gaps.description: EventBus stores events only in memory (_history list). All events are lost on process restart. No write-ahead log, no event store, no replay capability. Critical for agricultural operations where audit trails are required.
gaps.current_state: EventBus._history is a plain list. No persistence backend. No event store.
gaps.expected: Pluggable event store backend (in-memory, file-based, or database). Write-ahead log for durability. Event replay for recovery. Integration with TimescaleDB or PostgreSQL for long-term event storage.

gaps.title: Event bus has no delivery guarantees
gaps.description: EventBus provides no delivery guarantees. Events can be lost if a handler fails (the exception is caught and logged, but the event is not retried). No at-least-once or exactly-once semantics. No dead letter queue for failed events.
gaps.current_state: publish() catches handler exceptions and logs them. Failed events are not retried. No dead letter queue.
gaps.expected: Configurable delivery semantics: at-most-once (current), at-least-once (with retry), exactly-once (with deduplication). Dead letter queue for events that exceed max retries. Retry with exponential backoff.

gaps.title: Event bus has no event schema validation
gaps.description: DomainEvent accepts any payload dict with no schema validation. Events with malformed payloads are published without error. No contract between event producers and consumers.
gaps.current_state: DomainEvent.payload is Dict[str, Any] with no validation. No event schema registry.
gaps.expected: Event schema registry with JSON Schema or Pydantic models per event type. Validate payload on publish. Schema versioning for backward compatibility. Reject or flag events that don't conform to schema.

gaps.title: Event bus has no event versioning or evolution
gaps.description: No mechanism for evolving event schemas over time. Breaking changes to event payloads will silently break consumers. No version field on events.
gaps.current_state: DomainEvent has no version field. No schema evolution strategy.
gaps.expected: Add version field to DomainEvent. Support multiple concurrent schema versions. Upcaster pattern for transforming old events to new schema. Deprecation warnings for old event versions.

gaps.title: Event bus has no replay capability
gaps.description: Cannot replay historical events for debugging, testing, or recovery. No time-travel debugging. Cannot reconstruct state from event history.
gaps.current_state: get_history() returns events but there is no replay mechanism. No event sourcing support.
gaps.expected: Event replay by time range or event ID. Event sourcing pattern: reconstruct aggregate state from event log. Integration with FarmState for state reconstruction. Snapshot support for performance.

gaps.title: Event bus has no wildcard or pattern-based subscriptions
gaps.description: Subscribers must know exact event type strings. No support for wildcard patterns (e.g., 'sensor.*' or 'alert.#'). Limits flexibility in event-driven workflows.
gaps.current_state: subscribe() requires exact event type string. No pattern matching.
gaps.expected: Support for wildcard patterns: 'sensor.*' matches all sensor events, 'alert.#' matches alert hierarchy. Topic-based routing with hierarchical event types.

gaps.title: Event bus has no async handler support
gaps.description: All handlers are synchronous. Cannot integrate with async I/O operations (e.g., calling external APIs, writing to databases). Blocks the publishing thread during handler execution.
gaps.current_state: publish() calls handlers synchronously. No async/await support.
gaps.expected: AsyncEventBus with async publish() and async handler support. Backpressure handling for slow handlers. Optional sync-to-async bridge for gradual migration.

gaps.title: Event bus has no backpressure handling
gaps.description: If handlers are slow or the event rate is high, the event bus can be overwhelmed. No flow control, no buffering limits, no backpressure propagation to publishers.
gaps.current_state: No queue depth limits. No backpressure. Unbounded _history list can cause memory issues.
gaps.expected: Configurable queue depth limits. Backpressure: slow down or drop events when queue is full. Metrics for queue depth, publish rate, handler latency. Circuit breaker for failing handlers.

gaps.title: Event bus has no metrics or monitoring
gaps.description: No visibility into event bus health. Cannot monitor publish rates, handler latency, error rates, or queue depth. No integration with observability stack.
gaps.current_state: No metrics collection. No health check endpoint. No monitoring hooks.
gaps.expected: Metrics: events published per second, handler latency histogram, error rate, queue depth. Health check endpoint. Integration with Prometheus or OpenTelemetry. Structured logging for all bus operations.

gaps.title: Event bus has no distributed tracing
gaps.description: Events flow across modules but there is no tracing context propagated. Cannot trace an event from producer through all consumers. No correlation IDs for debugging distributed workflows.
gaps.current_state: No tracing context in DomainEvent. No correlation ID propagation.
gaps.expected: Add trace_id and span_id to DomainEvent. Propagate tracing context through handler chain. Integration with OpenTelemetry or Jaeger. End-to-end trace visualization for event flows.

gaps.title: Event bus has no event archival or compaction
gaps.description: Event history grows unbounded. No archival to cold storage. No compaction for event sourcing. Long-running systems will accumulate millions of events in memory.
gaps.current_state: _history is an unbounded list. No archival. No compaction.
gaps.expected: Configurable retention policy. Archive old events to cold storage (S3, file). Event compaction: replace detailed events with summary snapshots. TTL-based cleanup for transient events.

gaps.title: No onboarding API endpoints
gaps.description: Onboarding module has no REST API. Cannot integrate with the API gateway. No way to query tier recommendations or module lists via HTTP.
gaps.current_state: OrganizationProfiler and ModuleRegistry are pure Python classes with no API layer. No integration with api_gateway.py.
gaps.expected: REST endpoints: POST /api/v1/onboarding/recommend-tier, GET /api/v1/onboarding/modules/{tier}. Integration with the existing FastAPI gateway. Pydantic request/response models.

gaps.title: No onboarding workflow or state machine
gaps.description: Onboarding is a static tier-to-module mapping. No workflow engine for guiding users through onboarding steps. No state machine for tracking onboarding progress.
gaps.current_state: ModuleRegistry returns a static list of modules. No workflow, no state machine, no progress tracking.
gaps.expected: OnboardingWorkflow with state machine: not_started → in_progress → completed. Step-by-step guidance through modules. Progress tracking per tenant. Resume capability for interrupted onboarding.

gaps.title: No onboarding event publishing
gaps.description: Onboarding events (tier assigned, module completed, onboarding finished) are not published to the event bus. Other modules cannot react to onboarding state changes.
gaps.current_state: No integration with EventBus. Onboarding is a dead-end computation.
gaps.expected: Publish onboarding events: OnboardingStarted, ModuleCompleted, OnboardingCompleted, TierChanged. Integration with EventBus. Enable reactive workflows (e.g., 'when onboarding completes, provision default farm').

gaps.title: No onboarding analytics or metrics
gaps.description: No visibility into onboarding effectiveness. Cannot track completion rates, time-to-complete, or drop-off points. No A/B testing of onboarding flows.
gaps.current_state: No analytics. No metrics collection.
gaps.expected: Onboarding analytics: completion rate, time-to-complete per module, drop-off points. Integration with metrics collection. Dashboard for onboarding health.

gaps.title: FarmState has no history or time series
gaps.description: FarmState is a snapshot with no temporal dimension. Cannot track how farm state changes over time. No trend analysis, no rate-of-change detection, no historical comparison.
gaps.current_state: FarmState is a single snapshot. No history. No time series storage.
gaps.expected: FarmStateHistory with time-series storage. Trend analysis: soil moisture declining, temperature rising. Rate-of-change alerts. Historical comparison (e.g., 'moisture 20% lower than last week').

gaps.title: FarmState has no state diff or change tracking
gaps.description: Cannot determine what changed between two FarmState snapshots. No change detection for triggering events or alerts. No audit trail of state transitions.
gaps.current_state: No diff mechanism. No change tracking.
gaps.expected: FarmStateDiff that identifies changed fields and magnitude. Change events published to event bus. Audit trail of all state transitions. Integration with EventBus for change-driven workflows.

gaps.title: FarmState has no serialization or deserialization
gaps.description: FarmState cannot be serialized to JSON, protobuf, or other formats. Cannot be stored in databases or transmitted over networks. No schema definition for persistence.
gaps.current_state: FarmState is a plain dataclass with no to_dict(), from_dict(), or serialization methods.
gaps.expected: to_dict(), from_dict(), to_json(), from_json() methods. Pydantic model for validation and serialization. Protobuf schema for efficient network transmission. Avro schema for event store integration.

gaps.title: FarmState has no state transition validation
gaps.description: No validation of state transitions. Cannot enforce rules like 'soil_moisture cannot increase without irrigation event' or 'crop_height cannot decrease'. Invalid state transitions are silently accepted.
gaps.current_state: No transition validation. Any state change is accepted.
gaps.expected: StateTransitionValidator with rules: moisture increase requires irrigation, crop_height decrease requires harvest or stress event. Reject or flag invalid transitions. Integration with event bus for transition validation.

gaps.title: Unified optimizer has no solver selection heuristics
gaps.description: Cannot auto-select the best solver based on problem size, constraints, or hardware availability. Users must manually choose between TSP, VRP, GPU_TSP, GPU_VRP.
gaps.current_state: SolverType must be explicitly specified. No auto-selection logic.
gaps.expected: Auto-select solver based on problem characteristics: small problems → CPU, large problems → GPU, capacity constraints → VRP. Solver recommendation engine. Benchmark-based selection.

gaps.title: Unified optimizer has no timeout or retry handling
gaps.description: Solver calls have no timeout. A slow or hung solver blocks the entire pipeline. No retry logic for transient failures.
gaps.current_state: No timeout on solver calls. No retry logic.
gaps.expected: Configurable timeout per solver. Retry with exponential backoff for transient failures. Circuit breaker for consistently failing solvers. Fallback to simpler solver on timeout.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No shared event schema registry
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Event bus, farm state, and genomics modules have no shared schema definitions. Each module defines its own data structures with no contract between them.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No module health checks
cross_cutting_gaps.description: None of the audited modules expose health check endpoints or status indicators. Cannot monitor module health in production.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No configuration management
cross_cutting_gaps.description: No config file support for any audited module. Scoring models, solver parameters, and validation rules are hardcoded.

cross_cutting_gaps.title: No structured logging or correlation IDs
cross_cutting_gaps.description: Modules log independently with no correlation IDs. Cannot trace requests across module boundaries.
